llm_route_dimensions_check.name: llm_route_dimensions_check
llm_route_dimensions_check.value: (purpose = 'embedding') = (dimensions IS NOT NULL) AND (dimensions IS NULL OR dimensions > 0)

invitation_role_check.name: invitation_role_check
invitation_role_check.value: role IS NULL OR role IN ('Admin', 'Editor', 'Viewer')

access_request_decision_check.name: access_request_decision_check
access_request_decision_check.value:
(status = 'waiting') = (decided_at IS NULL)
         AND (decided_at IS NULL) = (decided_by IS NULL)
         AND (invitation_id IS NULL OR status = 'approved')

suggestion_reason_length_check.name: suggestion_reason_length_check
suggestion_reason_length_check.value: reason IS NULL OR char_length(reason) BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

suggestion_decision_check.name: suggestion_decision_check
suggestion_decision_check.value:
(status = 'waiting') = (decided_at IS NULL)
         AND (decided_at IS NULL) = (decider IS NULL)
         AND (target_iri IS NOT NULL) = (status = 'accepted')
         AND (reason IS NOT NULL) = (status IN ('declined', 'returned'))
